## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Northern Sòng pedagogical commentary on the preface (*xù*) of **Yuánzhào**'s ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7), 1048–1116) **Zīchí jì** 資持記 — Yuánzhào's principal sub-commentary on **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Sìfēnlǜ shānfán bǔquē xíngshì chāo* 四分律刪繁補闕行事鈔 ([KR6k0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0017)) — together with a structured *jiǎngyì* 講義 lecture-record on the *wǔlì* 五例 ("five examples"), composed by **Zéān** 則安 ([則安](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%89%87%E5%AE%89)), Yuánzhào's senior disciple.

**Abstract**

The work has two parts: (1) the *Xùjiě* — phrase-by-phrase glosses on Yuánzhào's preface to the *Zīchí jì* — and (2) the *Wǔlì jiǎngyì* — Zéān's five-fold pedagogical schema for teaching Yuánzhào's commentary. As the only surviving direct pedagogical record from Yuánzhào's immediate disciple-circle, the work is documentarily critical for reconstructing the early-twelfth-century *Língzhīsì* *Nánshānlǜ* teaching tradition. Composition postdates Yuánzhào's death (1116) — Zéān refers to him posthumously — and falls within Zéān's likely active period.
